visualReview.scope: Permanent detailed exterior and visible stadium bowl.
visualReview.notes: All17 portable and17 shared final frames inspected after two geometry revisions. Full-resolution membrane, roof/column contact and hospitality views confirm continuous fabric, sealed upper/lower tier transitions and no protruding column caps. Three colonnades, eight ramp banks, forty-eight radial cable/truss units, clear inner roof, light catwalk, two goal-end screens and three red seating tiers are legible.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Shared metric concrete, painted metal and membrane are visually consistent. Continuous roofXZ fabric UVs avoid independent tangent-projection seams between curved quads; construction bands and tie marks remain geometry. Transparent inner polycarbonate retains portable local alpha. Geographic terrain-cutout ray and restoration checks plus shared resource unload passed.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Primary architect photographs/section/plan and ArcelorMittal/SBP structural evidence constrain the actual309m colonnade with288columns, three diameter classes,22m tapered ring,48radial trusses and102m oculus. Membrane shape, internal row inventory, member thicknesses and ramp-bank details are reconstructed against those sources. Sponsor art, private service interiors and unbuilt optional retractable closure are excluded. This is an authored exterior interpretation, not an as-built fabrication or photogrammetric model.
